text:
Priya: Heads-up — opened a docs PR that bundles a Private migration guide + focused SDK transport examples for on-prem installs. Needs review before tomorrow's docs cut. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1428 :eyes:

Sam: Jumping in — can you summarize the top user flow changes? I want to call out any network-level preflight items.

Priya: Sure. TL;DR: (1) offline mirror step for air-gapped sites, (2) new optional installer flag --min-route-set to reduce BGP requirements, (3) explicit PKCS#11 path examples for common HSM vendors, (4) SDK transport fallback snippet (HTTP -> unix socket) for local agent.

Mike W: Sounds good. For the PKCS#11 examples please add vendor-specific env var names instead of a single generic path. Some customers use /opt/vendora/libpkcs11.so, others /usr/lib64/libpkcs11.so.

Priya: will do. Also added a short validation script link: scripts/validate-hsm.sh (in PR) — basic checks for library presence + permission bits.

Linh: Quick note on the mirror step — can we add an example rsync + apt/yum snapshot command? I ran into issues where customers forgot to include gpg keys for packages. Suggest we add a one-liner for Debian and one for RHEL.

Priya: added both. Example in the PR: 
```bash
# Debian mirror minimal
rsync -avz --delete rsync://mirror.example.com/debian/ /mnt/offline-mirror/debian/
# export GPG keys separately: apt-key add /mnt/offline-mirror/keys/repo.gpg
```

Nate: On the SDK side — the Node example looks fine but the Go example needs a fallback to unix socket when host networking is disabled. I sketched a snippet: 
```go
client, _ := sdk.New(&sdk.Config{Transport: "unix", SocketPath: "/var/run/redwood-agent.sock"})
// fallback to HTTP if socket not found
if _, err := os.Stat("/var/run/redwood-agent.sock"); os.IsNotExist(err) {
  client, _ = sdk.New(&sdk.Config{Transport: "http", Host: "127.0.0.1:8080"})
}
```

Priya: included that with attribution to you.

Mike W: Docs lint caught one flaky link — the install checklist anchor changed from #preflight to #pre-flight in another file. Can you run the link-checker script? I can fix but want to avoid CI failures.

DocOps Bot: docs-ci/build #582 completed — staging site: https://staging.docs.redwood-inference.internal/priv-migrate-1428 (build passed, spellcheck WARNING: pkgnames)

Priya: thanks bot. Sam — can you do a final pass on the networking section? Specifically: NAT/SNAT behavior for provider NAT gateways, and a short note about iptables vs nftables on older RHEL kernels. I added an explicit example command for creating the SNAT rule but want an engineer to sanity-check.

Sam: I can take that now. Quick glance: the SNAT example uses the installer variable INSTALLER_EGRESS_IFACE — are we documenting that env var in the reference? If not, add it to the installer flags table.

Priya: good catch — I'll add INSTALLER_EGRESS_IFACE to the flags table and link to the runtime env docs.

Linh: Also add a troubleshooting tip for HSM time skew — a lot of failures trace back to NTP not running. Small blurb: check 'chronyc sources' or 'timedatectl status'.

Priya: added the NTP blurb and a short remediation step.

Nate: Minor nit: the SDK snippet for credential refresh used a 5s ttl in the example. For most on-prem setups we'd recommend 30s or more to avoid thundering-refresh on temporary network blips.

Priya: updated to 45s default in the example.

Sam: LGTM pending the link fix and a quick reword on the installer flag description (make it explicit that --min-route-set only changes the required route table entries, not the full installer networking mode).

Priya: will push a tiny commit in 15m. If CI passes and @Mike W gives final sign-off, can we merge before EOD?

Mike W: Yep, I'll re-check the PKCS#11 paths and link-checker once you push. If the staging build has no broken anchors, :shipit:.

DocOps Bot: PR #1428 updated — new build queued (docs-ci/build #583).

Priya: thanks everyone. I'll ping if anything else pops up. If you see customers hitting this before the merge, share the staging link above. :handshake:
